title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
plot: A traveling showman arrives at a German village fair with a somnambulist who can supposedly predict the future. Soon after, a string of murders begins, and a young man becomes convinced the two strangers are responsible.
whyWatch: The jagged, painted sets of German Expressionism still look like a nightmare made solid.

title: Nosferatu
plot: An estate agent travels to the Carpathian mountains to sell a house to the reclusive Count Orlok. When the count sets sail for the agent's hometown, death and plague follow in his wake.
whyWatch: Max Schreck's rat-like vampire is still one of the eeriest faces in cinema.

title: The Phantom of the Opera
plot: A masked figure haunts the cellars beneath the Paris Opera House and becomes obsessed with a young singer. He schemes to make her a star, by any means necessary.
whyWatch: Lon Chaney's unmasking scene made audiences faint in 1925.

title: Frankenstein
plot: Obsessed young scientist Henry Frankenstein stitches together a body from stolen corpses and brings it to life in a lightning storm. His creation, confused and feared, escapes into the countryside.
whyWatch: Boris Karloff turns the monster into a tragic figure you can't stop watching.

title: Dracula
plot: A real-estate agent visits a Transylvanian count who soon relocates to London. As young women begin falling mysteriously ill, Professor Van Helsing suspects a vampire is at work.
whyWatch: Bela Lugosi defined the screen vampire for the rest of the century.

title: Vampyr
plot: A young traveler interested in the occult stops at a remote inn and is drawn into the affairs of a family whose daughter is wasting away. Shadows move on their own and the line between dream and waking dissolves.
whyWatch: A hazy, dreamlike fever that feels like a half-remembered nightmare.

title: Freaks
plot: A trapeze artist in a traveling circus learns that a performer in the sideshow has inherited a fortune and sets out to marry him for his money. The tight-knit sideshow community does not take kindly to betrayal.
whyWatch: Banned for decades, it remains one of the most startling films of its era.

title: Bride of Frankenstein
plot: Having survived the fire at the windmill, the Monster wanders the countryside seeking friendship. Meanwhile, the sinister Dr. Pretorius pressures Henry Frankenstein to build his creation a mate.
whyWatch: Witty, strange and moving; a sequel many think beats the original.

title: The Wolf Man
plot: Larry Talbot returns to his family's estate in Wales and is bitten while fighting off a wolf. Now, whenever the full moon rises, he transforms into a beast he cannot control.
whyWatch: Lon Chaney Jr. created the werewolf mythology most films still follow.

title: Cat People
plot: A Serbian fashion illustrator in New York marries a kind engineer but refuses to get close to him, fearing an old village legend. She believes strong emotion will turn her into a deadly panther.
whyWatch: A masterclass in suggestion: what you don't see is the scary part.

title: I Walked with a Zombie
plot: A Canadian nurse takes a job on a Caribbean plantation to care for the wife of the owner, a woman who seems to be in a waking trance. She begins to wonder whether a voodoo ritual could bring the patient back.
whyWatch: Poetic and moody: the zombie film before zombies ate brains.

title: The Uninvited
plot: A composer and his sister buy a bargain clifftop house on the Cornish coast. They soon discover why it was so cheap: a sobbing presence fills the house at night.
whyWatch: One of Hollywood's first serious ghost stories, and still a cozy chiller.

title: Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein
plot: Two hapless baggage clerks deliver crates that turn out to hold Dracula and Frankenstein's Monster. Dracula plans to put a new brain in the Monster, and one of the clerks has exactly the brain he wants.
whyWatch: Dracula, the Wolf Man and Frankenstein's Monster in one slapstick romp.

title: Ugetsu
plot: During a civil war in 16th-century Japan, a potter leaves his family to sell his wares in the city. There he is seduced by a mysterious noblewoman whose manor may not belong to the world of the living.
whyWatch: A haunting, beautiful ghost story from one of Japan's greatest directors.

title: Creature from the Black Lagoon
plot: A scientific expedition up the Amazon searches for fossils of a prehistoric link between fish and humans. They find one that is very much alive and does not want them to leave.
whyWatch: Classic monster-movie fun with stunning underwater photography.

title: Them!
plot: A police sergeant in the New Mexico desert finds a little girl in shock and a trailer torn open. The culprits are ants, mutated to enormous size by atomic testing.
whyWatch: The best of the 1950s giant-bug films, played completely straight.

title: Les Diaboliques
plot: The wife and the mistress of a cruel boarding-school headmaster join forces to murder him and dump the body in the school pool. Then the body vanishes.
whyWatch: An ending so famous the film asked audiences not to spoil it.

title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
plot: A small-town doctor hears from patient after patient that their loved ones are impostors. He discovers that emotionless duplicates are growing from alien seed pods.
whyWatch: Pure 1950s paranoia that hasn't aged a day.

title: Night of the Demon
plot: An American psychologist arrives in England to expose a devil-worship cult. The cult's leader slips him a parchment covered in runes and tells him he will die in three days.
whyWatch: A skeptic-versus-occult classic adapted from M. R. James.

title: Dracula (Horror of Dracula)
plot: Jonathan Harker arrives at Castle Dracula posing as a librarian, but secretly intends to destroy the count. When he fails, Dr. Van Helsing takes up the hunt.
whyWatch: Hammer Studios in full Technicolor, with Christopher Lee and Peter Cushing.

title: House on Haunted Hill
plot: An eccentric millionaire offers five strangers $10,000 each to spend a night in a notorious haunted house. Skeletons, acid vats and loaded pistols are all part of the party.
whyWatch: Vincent Price at his most deliciously theatrical.

title: Psycho
plot: A secretary on the run with stolen cash checks into a remote motel. The shy young manager seems harmless, but he lives with a domineering mother in the house on the hill.
whyWatch: The film that made everyone afraid of showers.

title: Eyes Without a Face
plot: A brilliant surgeon whose daughter's face was disfigured in a car crash kidnaps young women. He wants to graft their faces onto hers.
whyWatch: Elegant, poetic and quietly horrifying.

title: Black Sunday
plot: Two centuries after a witch is executed with a spiked mask, two doctors passing her crypt accidentally revive her. She sets out to possess her lookalike descendant.
whyWatch: Gorgeous black-and-white gothic from the father of Italian horror.

title: Peeping Tom
plot: A shy focus puller in London films women with a hidden camera as he kills them, capturing their terror. A kind neighbor begins to befriend him.
whyWatch: So disturbing it ended its director's career; now regarded as a masterpiece.

title: The Housemaid
plot: A piano teacher hires a young maid to help his family settle into their new two-story house. Her presence slowly tears the household apart.
whyWatch: A Korean classic that clearly inspired Parasite.

title: The Innocents
plot: A governess takes charge of two orphaned children at a vast country estate. She begins to believe the ghosts of the previous governess and her lover are trying to possess them.
whyWatch: Perhaps the most elegant ghost story ever filmed.

title: At Midnight I'll Take Your Soul
plot: Zé do Caixão, a sadistic gravedigger who mocks religion, terrorizes his village in his quest to find a woman to bear him a perfect son. The spirits of his victims are not content to stay buried.
whyWatch: Brazil's first horror film introduced the iconic Coffin Joe.

title: Kwaidan
plot: Four Japanese ghost stories: a samurai returns to the wife he abandoned, a woodcutter meets a snow spirit, a blind musician performs for an audience of the dead, and a writer sees a face in a cup of tea.
whyWatch: A painterly anthology of folk ghost tales; every frame is gorgeous.

title: Onibaba
plot: In a sea of tall reeds during a medieval civil war, a woman and her daughter-in-law survive by killing lost samurai and selling their armor. When a neighbor returns from the war, jealousy and a demon mask bring ruin.
whyWatch: Sweaty, primal and unforgettable, with a mask you'll see in your dreams.

title: Repulsion
plot: A withdrawn young manicurist is left alone in her sister's London flat for a weekend. As her isolation deepens, the apartment itself seems to turn on her.
whyWatch: Catherine Deneuve in a claustrophobic slide into madness.

title: Viy
plot: A young seminary student is ordered to read prayers for three nights over the body of a dead girl in a village church. Each night the witch rises and summons worse horrors.
whyWatch: Soviet-era folk horror with wild, handmade special effects.

title: Night of the Living Dead
plot: Strangers barricade themselves inside a rural Pennsylvania farmhouse as the recently dead rise and attack the living. Trapped together, the survivors can't agree on how to survive the night.
whyWatch: The birth of the modern zombie, made on a shoestring budget.

title: Rosemary's Baby
plot: A young couple moves into a grand old Manhattan apartment building with unusually attentive elderly neighbors. When Rosemary becomes pregnant, she begins to suspect a terrible plot around her unborn child.
whyWatch: Slow-burn paranoia in its most perfect form.

title: Kuroneko
plot: After being murdered by marauding soldiers, a woman and her daughter-in-law return as vengeful cat spirits who prey on samurai. A newly honored samurai is sent to destroy them.
whyWatch: Ghostly, theatrical and full of eerie beauty.

title: Witchfinder General
plot: During the English Civil War, a lawyer named Matthew Hopkins tours the countryside extracting confessions from accused witches for profit. A young soldier swears revenge after Hopkins targets his fiancée.
whyWatch: Vincent Price at his coldest; a cornerstone of British folk horror.

title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
plot: Five friends driving through rural Texas pick up a disturbing hitchhiker and then stop at an isolated farmhouse. Inside lives a family of cannibals, including a chainsaw-wielding giant in a mask of human skin.
whyWatch: Grimy, relentless and unforgettable: a genuine endurance test.

title: Black Christmas
plot: Over the Christmas break, a sorority house receives a series of obscene, unhinged phone calls. Then the women start disappearing one by one.
whyWatch: The proto-slasher that invented 'the calls are coming from inside the house'.

title: The Wicker Man
plot: A devout police sergeant flies to a remote Scottish island to investigate a missing girl. The islanders, who practice an ancient pagan religion, insist she never existed.
whyWatch: The ultimate folk-horror film, with songs you'll hum against your will.

title: Don't Look Now
plot: Grieving the drowning of their daughter, a couple travels to Venice for work. There, two elderly sisters claim the dead girl is trying to warn them of danger.
whyWatch: Grief-stricken, labyrinthine and haunted by a small red coat.

title: The Exorcist
plot: When a 12-year-old girl in Washington, D.C. begins behaving violently and speaking in a voice not her own, her desperate mother turns to the church. Two priests attempt an exorcism.
whyWatch: Still widely considered the scariest movie ever made.

title: Picnic at Hanging Rock
plot: On Valentine's Day 1900, a group of schoolgirls goes on a picnic to a volcanic rock formation in the Australian bush. Several of them climb the rock and never return.
whyWatch: A dreamy, unresolved mystery that gets under your skin.

title: Deep Red
plot: A jazz pianist witnesses the brutal murder of a psychic in Rome. He becomes obsessed with a detail he glimpsed at the crime scene, while the killer begins hunting him.
whyWatch: The definitive giallo, scored by prog-rock band Goblin.

title: Jaws
plot: A great white shark starts attacking swimmers off a New England resort island at the start of the summer season. The police chief, a marine biologist and a grizzled shark hunter set out to kill it.
whyWatch: Two notes of music and nobody wanted to go swimming again.

title: Carrie
plot: A bullied, sheltered high-school girl with a fanatically religious mother discovers she has telekinetic powers. When she is invited to the prom, her classmates plan a cruel prank.
whyWatch: Stephen King's first adaptation, and a prom night no one forgets.

title: House (Hausu)
plot: A schoolgirl and six friends spend their summer vacation at her aunt's remote country home. The house turns out to be hungry, and it eats them one by one.
whyWatch: Psychedelic, absurd and unlike anything you've seen.

title: Suspiria
plot: An American ballet student arrives at a prestigious dance academy in Freiburg on a stormy night. Students begin dying in gruesome ways, and she suspects the school hides a coven of witches.
whyWatch: Blazing color and a pounding score make it pure sensory horror.

title: Alucarda
plot: Two orphaned girls at a 19th-century Mexican convent form an intense bond. After they open a mysterious tomb, they fall under satanic influence and the convent descends into chaos.
whyWatch: Wild, operatic Mexican cult horror.

title: Halloween
plot: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween night, Michael Myers escapes a psychiatric hospital and returns to his hometown of Haddonfield. He begins stalking babysitter Laurie Strode and her friends as the holiday arrives.
whyWatch: The movie the holiday is named after, more or less. Mandatory on October 31.

title: Dawn of the Dead
plot: As the zombie outbreak overwhelms society, two SWAT officers, a TV traffic reporter and his girlfriend escape by helicopter. They take refuge in an abandoned shopping mall.
whyWatch: Gory, funny and a sharp satire of consumerism.

title: Long Weekend
plot: A bickering couple goes camping on a remote stretch of Australian beach and treats the land with contempt. Nature begins to fight back.
whyWatch: Eco-horror where the whole environment is the villain.

title: Alien
plot: The crew of a commercial space tug answers a distress signal from a desolate moon. One of them comes back with something attached to his face.
whyWatch: In space, no one can hear you scream. A perfect haunted-house film.

title: Nosferatu the Vampyre
plot: Jonathan Harker leaves his wife Lucy in Wismar to sell a house to Count Dracula in Transylvania. The lonely, plague-bearing count is drawn to Lucy and follows her home.
whyWatch: Klaus Kinski's melancholy vampire in Herzog's mournful remake.

title: Zombi 2 (Zombie Flesh Eaters)
plot: A woman searching for her missing father travels to a Caribbean island where a doctor is studying a plague that raises the dead. The island is overrun with rotting corpses.
whyWatch: Infamous splatter, including a zombie fighting a shark.

title: Friday the 13th
plot: Camp counselors arrive to reopen Camp Crystal Lake, which has been shuttered for years after a drowning and a pair of murders. An unseen killer begins picking them off one by one.
whyWatch: The summer-camp slasher that launched a franchise.

title: The Shining
plot: A struggling writer takes a job as winter caretaker of the isolated Overlook Hotel, bringing his wife and young son. The hotel's malevolent presence slowly drives him toward violence, while his son sees visions of its past.
whyWatch: Every shot is iconic. Here's Johnny!

title: The Fog
plot: As a California coastal town prepares to celebrate its 100th anniversary, a glowing fog rolls in from the sea. Inside it are the vengeful ghosts of shipwrecked sailors.
whyWatch: A campfire ghost story told with Carpenter's moody craftsmanship.

title: The Evil Dead
plot: Five college students vacationing in a remote cabin find a book of the dead and an audio recording of incantations. Playing the tape unleashes demons that possess them one by one.
whyWatch: Raw, inventive and gleefully gory; the ultimate cabin-in-the-woods movie.

title: An American Werewolf in London
plot: Two American backpackers are attacked by a wolf on the Yorkshire moors. The survivor, recovering in a London hospital, is visited by his decaying dead friend, who warns him about the next full moon.
whyWatch: Hilarious and horrifying, with a transformation scene that still astonishes.

title: The Beyond
plot: A young woman inherits a dilapidated hotel in Louisiana. While she renovates it, she learns that it was built over one of the seven gateways to hell.
whyWatch: Nightmare logic and gruesome set pieces from the Godfather of Gore.

title: Possession
plot: A spy returns home to West Berlin to find his wife wants a divorce. As he investigates her secret life, he discovers something far stranger than another man.
whyWatch: Isabelle Adjani's legendary performance in a ferocious breakup film.

title: Poltergeist
plot: A suburban California family notices playful supernatural activity in their new home. The fun stops when the spirits abduct their youngest daughter into another dimension.
whyWatch: They're here. A family-friendly scare machine with real bite.

title: The Thing
plot: Researchers at an Antarctic station take in a sled dog fleeing a Norwegian helicopter. It turns out to be a shape-shifting alien organism that can perfectly imitate any living thing.
whyWatch: Unbearable paranoia and the greatest practical effects ever put on film.

title: Videodrome
plot: The president of a sleazy Toronto TV station hunts for edgier programming and discovers a pirate broadcast of torture. Watching it begins to cause hallucinations and change his body.
whyWatch: Long live the new flesh. Cronenberg's prophetic media nightmare.

title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
plot: Teenagers on one suburban street are stalked in their dreams by a burned man with a bladed glove. If he kills you in your sleep, you die for real.
whyWatch: Freddy Krueger made going to bed the scariest thing you can do.

title: Gremlins
plot: A young man receives an adorable creature called a mogwai for Christmas, along with three rules for caring for it. When the rules are broken, the whole town is overrun by mischievous, destructive monsters.
whyWatch: Christmas chaos with a mean streak; the ideal gateway horror film.

title: Ghostbusters
plot: Three parapsychologists kicked out of their university start a ghost-removal business in New York City. Business booms just as an ancient god prepares to come through a portal on a Central Park West apartment building.
whyWatch: Who you gonna call? A perfect family-friendly October pick.

title: Razorback
plot: A monstrous wild boar terrorizes the Australian outback. An American man searching for his missing wife joins forces with a vengeful hunter to track the beast down.
whyWatch: A Jaws-on-land with stylish, music-video visuals.

title: Re-Animator
plot: A brilliant, arrogant medical student invents a glowing green serum that brings the dead back to life. The results are violent, messy and very hard to stop.
whyWatch: Splatter comedy at its most deranged, based on H. P. Lovecraft.

title: Fright Night
plot: A teenage horror fan is convinced his charming new next-door neighbor is a vampire. Nobody believes him, so he recruits a washed-up TV horror host to help.
whyWatch: Fun, sexy and spooky 1980s vampire mayhem.

title: Mr. Vampire
plot: A Taoist priest and his two bumbling apprentices are hired to rebury a wealthy man's father. The corpse rises as a hopping vampire, and kung fu and sticky rice are needed to stop it.
whyWatch: Hopping vampires and slapstick kung fu: pure joy.

title: The Fly
plot: An eccentric scientist builds a teleportation device and tests it on himself. A fly gets into the pod with him, and his body slowly begins to change.
whyWatch: A tragic love story disguised as a gross-out masterpiece.

title: Evil Dead II
plot: Ash brings his girlfriend to a remote cabin and plays a tape recording that awakens demons in the woods. Trapped through the night, he battles possessed corpses and even his own hand.
whyWatch: Slapstick and splatter in perfect, groovy balance.

title: Hellraiser
plot: A thrill-seeker solves a mysterious puzzle box and is torn apart by otherworldly beings called Cenobites. Later, a drop of blood in the attic of his old house lets him begin to come back.
whyWatch: Pinhead and the Cenobites: dark, perverse and iconic.

title: The Lost Boys
plot: Two brothers move with their mother to a California beach town. The older one falls in with a gang of leather-clad vampires, and the younger enlists two comic-book-store vampire hunters to save him.
whyWatch: Peak 1980s cool with fangs and a killer soundtrack.

title: A Chinese Ghost Story
plot: A timid debt collector spends the night in a haunted temple and falls in love with a beautiful ghost. She is enslaved by a monstrous tree demon, and he decides to set her free.
whyWatch: Romantic, swooping wuxia fantasy with a spooky heart.

title: Beetlejuice
plot: A recently deceased couple haunts their beloved country home and tries to scare away the obnoxious new owners. When their efforts fail, they hire a rude, chaotic 'bio-exorcist'.
whyWatch: Say his name three times. Tim Burton's gleeful afterlife comedy.

title: Child's Play
plot: A dying serial killer uses a voodoo ritual to transfer his soul into a talking doll. The doll ends up as a birthday present for a six-year-old boy.
whyWatch: Chucky made every toy aisle suspicious.

title: The Vanishing
plot: A young Dutch couple stops at a busy gas station in France and the woman disappears without a trace. Three years later, her obsessed boyfriend still searches for answers, and the abductor gets in touch.
whyWatch: Features one of the most devastating endings in film history.

title: Pet Sematary
plot: A doctor moves his family to rural Maine, next to a road with deadly truck traffic. An old neighbor shows him a burial ground in the woods that can bring the dead back.
whyWatch: Sometimes dead is better. Stephen King at his bleakest.

title: Tetsuo: The Iron Man
plot: A salaryman hits a stranger with his car and dumps the body. Soon, metal begins sprouting from his flesh as he transforms into a machine.
whyWatch: A frantic, industrial assault on the senses in stark black and white.

title: Tremors
plot: Two handymen in a tiny Nevada desert town are about to leave for good when giant worm-like creatures begin hunting people from underground. The residents must avoid touching the ground.
whyWatch: Easily one of the most entertaining monster movies ever made.

title: Misery
plot: A best-selling novelist crashes his car in a snowstorm and is rescued by a nurse who calls herself his number one fan. She is not pleased with his latest book.
whyWatch: Kathy Bates won an Oscar for one of cinema's scariest fans.

title: The Witches
plot: A young boy and his grandmother stay at an English seaside hotel that is hosting a secret convention of witches. Their Grand High Witch has a plan to turn all children into mice.
whyWatch: Roald Dahl with genuinely creepy Jim Henson effects; scary enough for brave kids.

title: The Addams Family
plot: A man claiming to be Gomez Addams' long-lost brother Fester returns to the family mansion. Some suspect he is an impostor in a scheme to steal the family fortune.
whyWatch: Delightfully macabre family fun.

title: Candyman
plot: A graduate student researching urban legends in Chicago investigates the myth of a hook-handed killer who appears when you say his name five times in a mirror. She decides to test it.
whyWatch: A haunting, operatic legend with Philip Glass's unforgettable score.

title: Braindead (Dead Alive)
plot: A meek young man's domineering mother is bitten by a Sumatran rat-monkey at the Wellington zoo and turns into a zombie. He tries to keep the spreading problem hidden in the basement.
whyWatch: Possibly the goriest film ever made, and one of the funniest.

title: Hocus Pocus
plot: On Halloween night in Salem, a teenager who just moved to town accidentally resurrects three 17th-century witch sisters. He, his little sister and a new friend must stop them before sunrise.
whyWatch: Required Halloween viewing for the whole family.

title: The Nightmare Before Christmas
plot: Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King of Halloween Town, is tired of the same old scares. When he stumbles into Christmas Town, he decides to take over Christmas.
whyWatch: Stop-motion magic that works for both holidays.

title: Cronos
plot: An elderly antiques dealer in Mexico City finds a golden scarab-shaped device hidden in a statue. It pierces his skin and gives him youth, along with a thirst for blood.
whyWatch: Del Toro's tender, strange debut about a very different vampire.

title: Casper
plot: A greedy heiress hires a therapist who specializes in the afterlife to clear the ghosts out of a Maine mansion. His lonely daughter befriends Casper, the friendly ghost.
whyWatch: Sweet, funny, and gently spooky for the youngest viewers.

title: Scream
plot: A year after her mother's murder, a teenage girl in a small California town is targeted by a masked killer obsessed with horror movies. Everyone knows the rules of slasher films, and that doesn't seem to help.
whyWatch: The clever, self-aware slasher that revived the genre.

title: The Frighteners
plot: A fake psychic investigator who can actually see ghosts uses his spectral friends to drum up business. When a deadly spirit starts marking the townspeople, he's the only one who can see it coming.
whyWatch: Michael J. Fox in a fun, inventive ghost caper.

title: Cure
plot: A Tokyo detective investigates a series of murders in which each killer, otherwise ordinary, carves an X into the victim's neck. All of them recently met the same strange, amnesiac young man.
whyWatch: A quiet, hypnotic crime-horror that seeps into your thoughts.

title: Cube
plot: Six strangers wake up inside a maze of interconnected cube-shaped rooms, some of which contain deadly traps. They must work out the logic of the structure to escape.
whyWatch: A brilliant low-budget puzzle box.

title: Funny Games
plot: A wealthy family arrives at their lakeside vacation home. Two polite young men in white gloves come over to borrow some eggs and take the family hostage.
whyWatch: A deliberately punishing film that challenges why we watch violence.

title: Ringu
plot: A journalist investigates rumors of a cursed videotape that kills anyone who watches it within seven days. After watching it herself, she races against time to uncover its origin.
whyWatch: The film that launched the J-horror wave, and a long-haired ghost.

title: The Blair Witch Project
plot: Three film students hike into the Maryland woods to make a documentary about a local witch legend. They get lost, and something keeps leaving things outside their tent at night.
whyWatch: The found-footage phenomenon that fooled the world.

title: The Sixth Sense
plot: A child psychologist tries to help a troubled, isolated boy in Philadelphia. The boy confides that he sees dead people.
whyWatch: A tender ghost story with an all-time classic twist.

title: Audition
plot: A lonely widower stages a fake film audition to find a new wife. He falls for a quiet, graceful young woman, but her past is darker than he imagines.
whyWatch: Starts as a romance; ends as one of the most infamous films ever made. Kiri kiri kiri.

title: Ginger Snaps
plot: Two death-obsessed teenage sisters in a Canadian suburb are inseparable. When the older one is bitten by a wild animal on the night of her first period, she begins changing in alarming ways.
whyWatch: A smart, funny werewolf film about growing up.

title: The Others
plot: In 1945 on the island of Jersey, a devout mother raises her two light-sensitive children in a darkened mansion. After new servants arrive, the children insist they've seen intruders in the house.
whyWatch: A refined, candlelit ghost story with a superb twist.

title: The Devil's Backbone
plot: During the Spanish Civil War, a young boy is left at a remote orphanage where an unexploded bomb sits in the courtyard. He begins to see the ghost of a child who once lived there.
whyWatch: A sorrowful, beautifully made ghost story.

title: Kairo (Pulse)
plot: In Tokyo, people begin vanishing after encountering strange images through the internet. Ghosts appear to be using the network to reach the world of the living.
whyWatch: A bleak, eerie meditation on loneliness in the digital age.

title: 28 Days Later
plot: A bike courier wakes up from a coma in a London hospital to find the city deserted. A rage virus has turned most of the population into fast, frenzied killers.
whyWatch: Reinvented the zombie film with sprinting infected.

title: Ju-On: The Grudge
plot: A curse born from a violent death lingers in a Tokyo house. Anyone who enters it, from a social worker to the new tenants, is marked by the vengeful spirits of a mother and her son.
whyWatch: That croaking sound will haunt you.

title: Dark Water
plot: A divorced mother fighting for custody of her daughter moves into a rundown apartment building. A spreading water stain on the ceiling is linked to a girl who went missing there.
whyWatch: A sad, damp, quietly devastating ghost story.

title: The Eye
plot: A violinist blind since childhood receives a cornea transplant. Her restored sight comes with visions of ghostly figures that no one else can see.
whyWatch: Elevator scene. That's all we'll say.

title: A Tale of Two Sisters
plot: Two sisters return from a mental institution to their family's country home, where they clash with their cold stepmother. Strange things begin happening in the house at night.
whyWatch: Lush, elegant and devastating; one of the best K-horror films.

title: High Tension
plot: Two college friends go to study at a family farmhouse in the French countryside. In the middle of the night, a brutal killer arrives.
whyWatch: Exactly what the title promises.

title: Shaun of the Dead
plot: Shaun, an aimless London electronics salesman, is trying to win back his girlfriend. He barely notices that the dead have risen, until he needs a plan involving his mum and the local pub.
whyWatch: Hilarious, heartfelt and the best zom-com ever made.

title: Saw
plot: Two men wake up chained to pipes in a filthy bathroom with a corpse between them. A killer called Jigsaw has set them a horrific game to play.
whyWatch: A twisty, grimy puzzle that launched a franchise.

title: Shutter
plot: A photographer and his girlfriend flee after a hit-and-run on a dark road. Afterward, mysterious shadows and faces start appearing in his photographs.
whyWatch: Thai horror with some of the genre's best jump scares.

title: The Descent
plot: A year after a family tragedy, six women go caving in the Appalachian mountains. A collapse traps them in an uncharted cave system, and they are not alone.
whyWatch: Claustrophobia plus monsters: unbearably tense.

title: Wolf Creek
plot: Three backpackers' car breaks down in the remote outback near the Wolf Creek crater. A friendly local offers them a tow back to his camp.
whyWatch: Mick Taylor is one of horror's most chilling villains.

title: Corpse Bride
plot: A nervous young groom practices his wedding vows in a dark forest and accidentally marries a dead bride. She whisks him off to the surprisingly lively Land of the Dead.
whyWatch: Gothic, romantic and gorgeously animated.

title: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
plot: Days before the town's giant vegetable contest, inventor Wallace and his dog Gromit run a humane pest-control business. A huge, mysterious beast begins ravaging the town's gardens at night.
whyWatch: A loving parody of Hammer horror films in plasticine.

title: The Host
plot: A mutated creature emerges from Seoul's Han River and snatches a young girl. Her dysfunctional family sets out to rescue her, defying the authorities.
whyWatch: A monster movie that's also funny, moving and political.

title: Monster House
plot: Three kids discover that the creepy house across the street is a living creature that swallows anything that comes near. Halloween is coming and trick-or-treaters are on the way.
whyWatch: A great first 'scary' movie for kids.

title: Black Sheep
plot: A man with a fear of sheep returns to his family's New Zealand farm. His brother's genetic experiments have produced killer sheep, and a bite turns people into were-sheep.
whyWatch: Exactly as silly as it sounds, and great fun.

title: Paranormal Activity
plot: A young couple sets up a video camera in their San Diego home to document the strange noises at night. What the camera records grows more threatening each night.
whyWatch: You'll stare at the corner of your bedroom for weeks.

title: [REC]
plot: A TV reporter and her cameraman follow firefighters on a night shift to an apartment building in Barcelona. The building is sealed off by authorities with everyone trapped inside, alongside something infectious.
whyWatch: Breathless, terrifying found footage.

title: The Orphanage
plot: A woman returns with her family to the seaside orphanage where she grew up, planning to reopen it. Her adopted son begins talking to invisible friends, and then he disappears.
whyWatch: Scary and heartbreaking in equal measure.

title: The Mist
plot: After a storm, a thick mist rolls over a small Maine town, trapping a group of shoppers in a supermarket. Monsters lurk in the mist, but the people inside may be just as dangerous.
whyWatch: Famous for one of the bleakest endings in horror.

title: Trick 'r Treat
plot: Four interwoven tales play out in a small Ohio town on Halloween night. A small trick-or-treater in burlap pajamas enforces the rules of the holiday.
whyWatch: Perhaps the most Halloween-y movie ever made.

title: Let the Right One In
plot: A lonely, bullied boy in a snowy Stockholm suburb befriends the strange girl who has moved in next door. She only comes out at night.
whyWatch: A chilly, tender vampire coming-of-age story.

title: Martyrs
plot: Fifteen years after escaping captivity as a child, a young woman tracks down the family she believes was responsible. What she uncovers is far worse than revenge.
whyWatch: Only for the brave. One of the most extreme films of its decade.

title: Lake Mungo
plot: After 16-year-old Alice drowns, her family in Ararat begins experiencing strange occurrences and finds her face in photos and videos. A documentary pieces together what Alice was hiding.
whyWatch: A sad, quietly terrifying mock documentary.

title: Pontypool
plot: A shock jock begins his morning shift at a small-town Ontario radio station. Strange reports come in of mobs attacking people, and the infection seems to spread through language itself.
whyWatch: A brainy zombie film set almost entirely in one room.

title: Cloverfield
plot: A going-away party in Manhattan is interrupted when a giant monster attacks the city. A group of friends filming the night head into the chaos to rescue someone.
whyWatch: A kaiju movie seen from the street through a shaky camcorder.

title: Coraline
plot: A bored girl in a new house finds a small door leading to a parallel world where her 'Other Mother' is attentive and fun. The catch: she must sew buttons over her eyes to stay.
whyWatch: A dark fairytale that's genuinely creepy for kids and adults.

title: Insidious
plot: A family's young son falls into an inexplicable coma, and terrifying things begin happening in the house. Moving doesn't help: it isn't the house that's haunted.
whyWatch: A masterclass in jump scares.

title: Tucker & Dale vs. Evil
plot: Two kind-hearted hillbillies go to fix up their vacation cabin. A group of college kids mistakes them for killers, and a series of misunderstandings turns deadly.
whyWatch: A brilliant upside-down slasher comedy.

title: Rare Exports
plot: An archaeological dig on a Finnish mountain uncovers something ancient. Reindeer are slaughtered, children go missing, and a young boy realizes the real Santa Claus is no jolly old man.
whyWatch: A darkly funny folk tale.

title: Trollhunter
plot: Students investigating a suspected bear poacher follow a gruff man into the Norwegian wilderness. He turns out to be a government trollhunter.
whyWatch: Deadpan Norwegian humor meets towering folklore monsters.

title: The Silent House
plot: A young woman and her father spend the night in a dilapidated country house they've been hired to clean up before it's sold. Strange noises start coming from upstairs.
whyWatch: Presented as one continuous, real-time shot.

title: The Cabin in the Woods
plot: Five friends head to a remote cabin for the weekend. Meanwhile, technicians in a mysterious underground facility are watching, and they have plans for the group.
whyWatch: A love letter to (and dissection of) the entire horror genre.

title: Kill List
plot: A former soldier turned hitman, struggling financially, takes a new contract with his partner. The jobs on their list grow increasingly strange and sinister.
whyWatch: A crime film that turns into a nightmare.

title: Juan of the Dead
plot: When zombies overrun Havana, the government blames dissidents funded by the US. A slacker named Juan sees a business opportunity: 'Juan of the Dead, we kill your loved ones'.
whyWatch: Cuba's first horror film is a sly political comedy.

title: ParaNorman
plot: A misunderstood boy who can talk to the dead must save his town from a centuries-old witch's curse. Zombies, ghosts and grown-ups get in his way.
whyWatch: Stop-motion with real heart, from the makers of Coraline.

title: Frankenweenie
plot: After his beloved dog Sparky is hit by a car, young Victor Frankenstein uses the power of lightning to bring him back to life. His classmates soon want to try it too.
whyWatch: A black-and-white tribute to the Universal monster films for kids.

title: The Conjuring
plot: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren are called to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their Rhode Island farmhouse. They find the evil there is stronger than any they've faced.
whyWatch: Old-fashioned haunted-house scares done perfectly. Want to play hide and clap?

title: The House at the End of Time
plot: A woman is released from prison 30 years after being convicted of killing her husband and son. She returns to the old house in Caracas, determined to discover what really happened that night.
whyWatch: A clever, emotional mystery that rewards attention.

title: The Babadook
plot: A widowed mother struggling to raise her troubled six-year-old son finds a sinister pop-up book called Mister Babadook. Once read, its creature refuses to go away.
whyWatch: A powerful film about grief disguised as a monster movie.

title: What We Do in the Shadows
plot: A documentary crew follows four vampire flatmates in Wellington as they deal with chores, nightclubs and a rival pack of werewolves. A newly turned vampire upsets the household balance.
whyWatch: The funniest vampire film ever made.

title: Housebound
plot: A troublemaking young woman is sentenced to house arrest in her chatty mother's rambling old home. She becomes convinced the house is haunted.
whyWatch: Twisty, scary and very funny.

title: Goodnight Mommy
plot: Twin boys await their mother's return to their remote lakeside home after facial surgery. When she arrives with her face bandaged and her behavior changed, they suspect she's an impostor.
whyWatch: Chilly, unsettling and hard to shake.

title: It Follows
plot: After a sexual encounter, a young woman in suburban Detroit learns she is being followed by a shape-shifting entity that walks slowly toward her, always. The only way to get rid of it is to pass it on.
whyWatch: A brilliantly simple premise and dread in every wide shot.

title: Creep
plot: A videographer answers an online ad to film a man in a remote cabin for a day. The man's behavior becomes increasingly strange.
whyWatch: Mark Duplass is unforgettable in this awkward, creepy two-hander.

title: Ojuju
plot: In a Lagos slum, the community's only water source has been contaminated. Residents start turning into raging zombies, and a young man must protect his pregnant girlfriend.
whyWatch: Nigeria's first zombie film, with a sharp message about clean water.

title: The Blue Elephant
plot: A psychiatrist returns to work at a Cairo mental hospital's ward for the criminally insane. He is assigned to assess an old friend accused of murder, and the case pulls him into something supernatural.
whyWatch: A stylish Egyptian blockbuster that mixes the mind and the occult.

title: The Witch
plot: In 1630s New England, a Puritan family is banished from their settlement and builds a farm at the edge of a forest. When their newborn vanishes, suspicion and fear tear them apart.
whyWatch: Wouldst thou like to live deliciously? Pure, earthy dread.

title: Train to Busan
plot: A workaholic fund manager boards a high-speed train to take his young daughter to see her mother. A zombie outbreak erupts on board and across the country.
whyWatch: Relentless action with a surprisingly big heart.

title: The Wailing
plot: A bumbling policeman in a mountain village investigates a series of violent murders and a mysterious illness. Rumors blame a Japanese stranger living in the woods, and a shaman is called in.
whyWatch: A sprawling, ambiguous epic of dread.

title: Raw
plot: A strict vegetarian starts veterinary school, where she is forced to eat raw meat in a hazing ritual. She develops an overwhelming new hunger.
whyWatch: A bold, darkly funny coming-of-age body horror.

title: Terrifier
plot: On Halloween night, two young women leaving a party encounter a silent, grinning clown. Art the Clown's gruesome rampage begins.
whyWatch: Extremely gory, made for those who want maximum shock.

title: Get Out
plot: A young Black photographer visits his white girlfriend's family at their secluded estate. Their overly accommodating welcome hides something deeply sinister.
whyWatch: Smart, funny and terrifying; an Oscar-winning modern classic.

title: It
plot: In the summer of 1989, a group of misfit kids in Derry, Maine, are terrorized by a shape-shifting entity that usually appears as a clown. They band together to fight it.
whyWatch: Pennywise plus friendship: the biggest horror hit ever.

title: One Cut of the Dead
plot: A low-budget film crew shooting a zombie movie in an abandoned water plant is attacked by real zombies. That's only the beginning of the story.
whyWatch: Keep watching past the first half hour. Trust us.

title: Tigers Are Not Afraid
plot: After her mother disappears in Mexico's drug war, a young girl joins a gang of street orphans. She is given three wishes and the ghosts of the dead begin following her.
whyWatch: A fairy tale steeped in sorrow and real-world horror.

title: Terrified
plot: Strange events plague several houses on one suburban street in Buenos Aires. A group of paranormal investigators decides to spend the night in the affected homes.
whyWatch: Some of the scariest images of the decade.

title: Good Manners
plot: A lonely nurse is hired by a wealthy, pregnant woman in São Paulo to be her nanny. The pregnancy is unusual, and the full moon reveals why.
whyWatch: A genre-blending fairytale with romance and musical moments.

title: Satan's Slaves
plot: After a long illness, a family's mother dies, and their struggling household is left in the countryside. She appears to return, ringing her little bell in the night.
whyWatch: A massive Indonesian hit with superb old-school scares.

title: Happy Death Day
plot: A self-centered college student is murdered by a masked killer on her birthday, and then wakes up to live the same day again. She must solve her own murder to break the loop.
whyWatch: Groundhog Day as a slasher: breezy and clever.

title: Hereditary
plot: After the family matriarch dies, her daughter Annie and the rest of the Graham family begin uncovering dark secrets about their ancestry. Grief turns into something more horrifying.
whyWatch: A modern horror landmark; prepare to be shaken.

title: A Quiet Place
plot: A family survives in silence on a farm after creatures that hunt by sound have overrun the world. Making a noise means death, and a baby is on the way.
whyWatch: You'll be afraid to eat your popcorn.

title: Tumbbad
plot: In a rain-soaked village in colonial India, a man returns again and again to an ancestral mansion where a cursed god is said to guard treasure. Greed drives him ever deeper.
whyWatch: A dark mythological fable with stunning production design.

title: Stree
plot: In a small Indian town, a female spirit abducts men during an annual festival, leaving only their clothes behind. A young tailor and his friends try to solve the mystery.
whyWatch: A hugely fun Bollywood horror comedy.

title: The Wolf House
plot: A young woman escapes from a German religious colony in southern Chile and takes refuge in a house in the woods. The house and its inhabitants shift and transform around her.
whyWatch: Ever-morphing stop-motion that feels like a fever dream.

title: The Nightshifter
plot: A night-shift worker at a São Paulo morgue has the ability to talk to the dead. When he uses their secrets to change his own life, he breaks a rule and brings a curse home.
whyWatch: Gruesome, grim Brazilian horror with a great hook.

title: Dachra
plot: Three journalism students investigate the case of a woman found mutilated decades ago and accused of witchcraft. Their search leads them to an isolated village in the woods.
whyWatch: Tunisia's first horror film is a gruesome folk nightmare.

title: Midsommar
plot: A grieving young woman joins her distant boyfriend and his friends on a trip to a remote Swedish commune's midsummer festival. In endless daylight, the celebration becomes increasingly disturbing.
whyWatch: Horror in broad daylight and a breakup film like no other.

title: Us
plot: A family vacationing in Santa Cruz is confronted one night by four strangers in red jumpsuits standing in their driveway. The strangers are their exact doubles.
whyWatch: Lupita Nyong'o gives two astonishing performances.

title: The Lighthouse
plot: Two lighthouse keepers on a remote New England island in the 1890s start to lose their minds. A storm strands them there long past their assignment.
whyWatch: Salty, hallucinatory, and full of mermaids and seagulls.

title: Atlantics
plot: In a Dakar suburb, unpaid construction workers set out by sea for Spain, leaving behind the woman one of them loves. Shortly after, a fever spreads and the young men seem to return.
whyWatch: A dreamy, romantic ghost story; winner at Cannes.

title: Saint Maud
plot: A pious young nurse becomes the live-in carer of a retired dancer dying of cancer in a seaside town. She believes it is her mission to save her patient's soul.
whyWatch: A sharp, unnerving portrait of faith and loneliness.

title: Detention
plot: In 1962 under martial law in Taiwan, two students wake up alone in their high school during a storm. Ghosts roam the halls, and they must confront what happened to their secret book club.
whyWatch: A haunting adaptation of the acclaimed horror video game.

title: La Llorona
plot: A retired general accused of genocide in Guatemala's civil war has his conviction overturned. Protesters surround his home, and a mysterious new maid arrives.
whyWatch: A classic legend reworked as a ghost story of justice.

title: Relic
plot: A woman and her daughter travel to the family's isolated country home after her elderly mother goes missing. She returns, but something has come back with her.
whyWatch: A tender, frightening film about dementia and inheritance.

title: His House
plot: A refugee couple from South Sudan is granted asylum in England and placed in a run-down house. Something terrifying followed them on their journey.
whyWatch: A brilliantly scary haunted-house film with deep meaning.

title: Bulbbul
plot: In 19th-century Bengal, a child bride grows into the mysterious lady of a mansion. Men in the village are dying, and rumors spread of a witch with backward-turned feet.
whyWatch: A blood-red feminist folk tale.

title: Freaky
plot: A shy high-school girl swaps bodies with a notorious serial killer after he stabs her with a cursed dagger. She has 24 hours to switch back.
whyWatch: Freaky Friday as a slasher, with Vince Vaughn as a teenage girl.

title: The Medium
plot: A documentary crew follows a shaman in rural northeastern Thailand. When her niece begins behaving strangely, it becomes clear she isn't being visited by the family goddess.
whyWatch: A brutal, escalating possession film.

title: Lamb
plot: A childless couple on a remote Icelandic sheep farm discovers a mysterious newborn in their barn. They decide to raise it as their own.
whyWatch: Strange, quiet and unforgettable.

title: Saloum
plot: Three legendary mercenaries escape a coup in Guinea-Bissau with a drug lord and a stash of gold. Hiding out in a remote camp in Senegal's Saloum delta, they find a supernatural danger.
whyWatch: A stylish blend of action, western and monster movie.

title: Gaia
plot: A forest ranger on patrol in a South African forest is injured and rescued by a father and son living off the grid. They worship a fungal god, and the forest is very much alive.
whyWatch: Eco-horror with gorgeous, unsettling fungal imagery.

title: Good Madam
plot: A young woman moves with her daughter into the Cape Town home of the bedridden white woman her mother has served for decades. A sinister force seems to be at work in the house.
whyWatch: A smart, slow-burn horror about the legacy of apartheid.

title: Smile
plot: A psychiatrist witnesses a patient's bizarre death; the patient was smiling. Afterwards, she begins seeing grinning figures and fears she's next.
whyWatch: A slick, effective scare machine.

title: Barbarian
plot: A young woman arrives at a Detroit Airbnb late at night to find it has been double-booked by a stranger. That's just the start of her problems.
whyWatch: Go in knowing as little as possible.

title: X
plot: In 1979, a group of young filmmakers rents a guesthouse on a rural Texas farm to shoot an adult film. Their elderly hosts disapprove, to put it mildly.
whyWatch: A gory throwback to 1970s grindhouse.

title: Nope
plot: Two siblings who run a horse ranch for Hollywood productions spot something unexplained in the sky above their California valley. They try to capture it on camera.
whyWatch: A spectacular summer blockbuster with a monster you've never seen before.

title: Speak No Evil
plot: A Danish family befriends a Dutch family on holiday in Tuscany and accepts an invitation to visit their remote home. Politeness keeps them from leaving when things start feeling wrong.
whyWatch: Being too polite has never been this terrifying.

title: Incantation
plot: Six years after breaking a religious taboo in a remote village, a mother takes back her young daughter from foster care. A curse soon falls on the girl, and the mother asks the viewer for help.
whyWatch: Taiwan's scariest film ever, and it wants you to participate.

title: Talk to Me
plot: A group of Adelaide teens discovers an embalmed hand that lets them be possessed by spirits for a few seconds. The trend becomes an addiction, and someone holds on too long.
whyWatch: A fresh, viral-era possession movie.

title: Huesera: The Bone Woman
plot: A young woman in Mexico City longs to become a mother. After she becomes pregnant, a sinister presence starts following her, and her bones begin to crack.
whyWatch: An unsettling story about unspoken fears of motherhood.

title: When Evil Lurks
plot: Two brothers in rural Argentina discover a man rotting with a demonic possession that threatens to spread. They try to get rid of him and make the outbreak much worse.
whyWatch: Merciless and terrifying: nothing is safe.

title: Mami Wata
plot: In a West African coastal village, the intermediary of the water goddess Mami Wata loses the people's trust. As a rebellion grows, her daughters must defend their faith.
whyWatch: Stunning black-and-white photography in a mythic folk tale.

title: Late Night with the Devil
plot: On Halloween night 1977, a struggling talk-show host stages a live occult special to boost his ratings. His star guest is a girl said to be possessed by a demon.
whyWatch: A fun, retro 'lost broadcast' that goes horribly wrong.

title: Exhuma
plot: A shaman, her apprentice, a geomancer and a mortician are hired by a wealthy family plagued by a curse. They must move an ancestor's grave, and they unearth something far worse.
whyWatch: Korea's mega-hit occult thriller.

title: Longlegs
plot: A gifted FBI agent is assigned to a decades-long case of family murder-suicides linked by coded letters. The clues point to an elusive killer and an occult connection to her own past.
whyWatch: Suffocating, eerie dread from the first frame.

title: The Substance
plot: A fading fitness-TV star is fired on her 50th birthday. She takes a black-market drug that creates a younger, more perfect version of herself, but the two must share their life by strict rules.
whyWatch: A gloriously gross satire with Demi Moore at her best.

title: Sinners
plot: In 1932 Mississippi, twin brothers return home to open a juke joint for the local community. On opening night, a group of strangers shows up whose interest in the music hides a darker hunger.
whyWatch: A blues-soaked vampire epic.

title: Weapons
plot: One night at 2:17 a.m., all but one child from a single school classroom get up, walk out of their homes and disappear. The town looks for answers, and blame.
whyWatch: A puzzle-box mystery told from multiple points of view.
